name: unhcr-refugee-data-finder
description: The UNHCR asylum-applications distribution has just been refreshed to carry complete data for year D. For an asylum corridor (country of origin O, country of asylum H) whose government-procedure applications in year D are at least 500 and whose year-D-1 value is published, will the corridor's year-D+1 government-procedure application total reach at least twice the year-D total?
split: temporal on the label year: train 2002-2016 shipped (window start 2001; label-year 2001 contributes no rows under the year-D-1 rule), eval 2017-2021, holdout 2022-2025
split_description: temporal on the label year (D+1): train 2002-2016 shipped (window start 2001; label-year 2001 contributes no rows), eval 2017-2021, holdout 2022-2025; eligibility requires a published year-D corridor total >= 500 persons and a published year-D-1 value
